repository_ui.title: Project repositories
repository_ui.description: Connect your account when AI needs repository access, or connect here in advance. Connections never grant project membership.
repository_ui.failed: The operation failed. Check your connection and try again.
repository_ui.saved: Connection saved. Return to your AI conversation and retry the read.
repository_ui.load_failed: Unable to load repositories. Check project membership and sign-in status.
repository_ui.empty: No repositories configured. Ask a project administrator to add one.
repository_ui.not_connected: Not connected. You can connect when access is needed.
repository_ui.scope: Uses your own account. Authorization does not grant repository membership.
repository_ui.github_scope: GitHub OAuth requests repo access, which may include write permissions upstream. Plane uses it only for reads in your authorized projects.
repository_ui.oauth_unavailable: Browser authorization is not configured for this host. An administrator must register the OAuth application; you can use a personal token below.
repository_ui.manual: Use an existing connection or personal token

results.connected: Connected and repository access verified. Return to your AI conversation to continue.
results.cancelled: Authorization cancelled. Your previous connection was not changed.
results.repository_authorization_required: Connect your account for this repository, then retry.
results.repository_oauth_not_configured: Browser authorization is not configured for this hosting instance.
results.upstream_access_denied: This account lacks permission. Ask the repository administrator for access or use another account.
results.upstream_authentication_required: The upstream credential is invalid. Reconnect or replace it.
results.upstream_resource_invisible: The repository or file does not exist, or this account cannot see it.
results.upstream_unavailable: The hosting service is unavailable. Try again later.
results.upstream_rate_limited: The hosting service is rate limiting requests. Try again later.
results.authorization_failed: Authorization could not be completed. Return to this project and retry.
results.file_too_large: File exceeds the preview size limit. Open it on the hosting platform.
results.lfs_file: Open this LFS file on the hosting platform.
results.configuration_conflict: This repository is already configured or its settings conflict.
